widespread

(adjective). phổ biến rộng rãi

Ex: The storm caused widespread damage.

(adverb). không nghi ngờ gì

Ex: There is undoubtedly a great deal of truth in what he says.

Ex: It would be seriously misleading to suggest that television has no effect on children.

approach

(noun). cách tiếp cận, phương pháp

Ex: The approach they were using no longer seemed to work.

accuse

(verb). buộc tội

Ex: She accused him of lying.
